preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 10,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= n <= 1000 and 2 <= m <= 1000 for n, m in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For every test case, dimensions N and M are between 2 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(b) == n * m and len(set(b)) == n * m for n, m, b in test_cases)
preconditions.description: For every test case, the array B contains exactly N*M distinct integers.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= 10**9 for b in test_cases for x in b)
preconditions.description: All elements in B are integers between 1 and 10^9 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: sum(n * m for n, m, _ in test_cases) <= 10**6
preconditions.description: The sum of N*M over all test cases does not exceed 10^6.

postconditions.expression: all(len(grid) == n and all(len(row) == m for row in grid) for n, m, grid in outputs)
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output grid has exactly N rows and M columns.

postconditions.expression: all(set(val for row in grid for val in row) == set(b) for b, grid in zip(all_B, outputs))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output grid contains exactly the same elements as the input array B.

postconditions.expression: all(min_score(grid, n, m) == min_possible_score(n, m, b) for n, m, b, grid in zip(all_N, all_M, all_B, outputs))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the constructed grid achieves the minimum possible score defined by the game rules, where the score is the difference between the maximum and minimum elements visited by the car starting at (1,1) and moving to (N,M) according to the alternating turn rules.
